c-member-share.1.evidence: Share on topic 16656 opens a dropdown with Copy link, Twitter / X, Facebook, LinkedIn.

c-member-share.2.evidence: Copy link calls navigator.clipboard.writeText with the topic URL (spied; real paste not possible in this harness) and shows toast "Link copied"

c-member-share.3.evidence: Twitter/X, Facebook, LinkedIn call window.open(_blank, 600x400) with twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=<enc>&text=<enc title>, facebook sharer u=<enc>, linkedin share-offsite url=<enc>

c-member-share.4.evidence: Dropdown closes on page scroll and on a click outside.

c-member-share.5.evidence: Escape closes the dropdown, also after Tab into it, and focus returns to the Share button (aria-label Share).

c-member-share.6.evidence: guest sees the same four items on a public topic

c-member-share.7.evidence: Partner Program and CAB topics return 404 to guests on page and oEmbed so Share never exposes a body; for a member the link is the same private URL. Member-side share control on a Partner topic not separately screenshotted.

c-member-share.8.evidence: GET /oembed?url=<public topic> = 200 with title and author (Sofia Romano); CAB and Partner topic URLs = 404 jetonomy_oembed_not_found

c-member-share.9.evidence: Grace 159-char title: dropdown inside viewport, X link text param is the full encoded 159-char title

c-member-share.10.evidence: 390px with html dir=rtl: dropdown spans x 40 to 227 of 390, inside the viewport; Escape closes it.

c-member-share.11.evidence: clipboard rejected: toast "Could not copy the link. Copy it from the address bar."
